evidence.observation: T701 reads 443.6 °C versus T702 70.5 °C and reboiler T703 72.0 °C, a large heater-temperature discrepancy.
Discrepancy persists throughout the observations: T701 is 443.6 °C, T702 69.7 °C and T703 72.4 °C; actual overheating versus a measurement fault is unresolved.
Distillate and reflux flows briefly rise to 0.8 and 3.1, respectively, before returning to 0.1 and 0.3 by 1140 s.
Upper-column temperatures remain 63.3 °C and cooling-water flow is 7.1; these do not independently corroborate the extreme T701 reading.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature verification, heater setpoint and permitted temperature range, heater power and sensor diagnostics are needed to distinguish overheating from a measurement fault. No composition measurement or separation target has been supplied. Pressure instruments are not installed, so pressure behavior cannot be assessed.
